properties.text: THE SELF-BALANCING WHEATSTONE BRIDGE -- the instrument that recorded furnace and process temperatures for most of the twentieth century.  A platinum sensor (Pt100: 100 Ω at 0 °C, 0.385 % more per degree) sits in the unknown arm Rx.  The two knobs are the world and the operator: TEMPERATURE T heats the sensor, RATIO ARM R1 sets the bridge's range.  The three calculators are the instrument, one job each.  PT100 SENSOR: the sensor's resistance at T.  SERVO: the motor that turns the rheostat R3 until the bridge balances, R3 = R1·Rx / R2 -- but R3 ends at 400 Ω, so the servo can only go that far.  READING: the temperature the instrument reads back off R3, the only thing a real one can see.  The figure takes all five numbers on five named inputs and decides nothing; it works the galvanometer current out itself, from the whole circuit, and draws the needle from it.  Wind the temperature and the servo chases it: the blue pointer climbs the dial, the reading follows T exactly, and the needle stays dead on zero -- balance does not even depend on the battery.  Turn R1 up and the same temperature needs more of R3: the range shrinks, until the pointer hits the red stop at the top of the dial.  Then the bridge is out of balance, the needle kicks red, and the reading sticks at the highest temperature this range can show.

properties.expression:
T = value
R0 = 100
alpha = 0.00385

Rx = R0 * (1 + alpha * T)

R2 = 100
R3max = 400

R3 = clamp(R1 * Rx / R2, 0, R3max)

properties.program:
# THE SELF-BALANCING WHEATSTONE BRIDGE
#
# Five inputs, one per wire: the temperature T and the ratio arm R1,
# straight from the knobs; Rx, the platinum sensor's resistance at T
# (the Pt100 sensor); R3, where the servo turned the balancing
# rheostat (the Servo); and Tm, the temperature the instrument reads
# off R3 (the Reading).  The figure decides nothing.  It checks the
# balance itself: the galvanometer current below is worked out here,
# from the whole circuit, and the needle is drawn from it.

# --- the circuit's fixed parts ----------------------------------------
R2    = 100        # the other ratio arm, ohms
R3max = 400        # the end of the rheostat
V     = 2          # the battery, volts
Rg    = 50         # the galvanometer's own resistance
Ifs   = 50e-6      # its full-scale current, amperes

# --- what the galvanometer sees: Thevenin across B and D ----------------
Vth = V * (R2 / (R1 + R2) - Rx / (R3 + Rx))
Rth = R1 * R2 / (R1 + R2) + R3 * Rx / (R3 + Rx)
Ig  = Vth / (Rth + Rg)
uA  = round(Ig * 1e6, 1) + 0
off = abs(uA) >= 0.1
phi = radians(55 * clamp(Ig / Ifs, -1, 1))

view -66, -49.5, 66, 49.5
align "centre", "middle"

# --- the four corners of the diamond ------------------------------------
xa = -26
ya = 28
xb = -54
xd = 2
yc = -28
xs = 18         # the rheostat's dial

# --- the wires ----------------------------------------------------------
color "#202020"
width 0.6
line xa, ya, xb, 0
line xb, 0, xa, yc
line xa, ya, xd, 0
line xd, 0, xa, yc
line xb, 0, xa - 8, 0
line xa + 8, 0, xd, 0
# the battery, across the top and bottom corners
line xa, ya, xa, 40
line xa, 40, -64, 40
line -64, 40, -64, -40
line -64, -40, -46, -40
line -42, -40, xa, -40
line xa, -40, xa, yc
width 1
line -46, -44, -46, -36
width 2
line -43, -42, -43, -38
width 0.6
line -43, -40, -42, -40
font 3.6
align "centre", "bottom"
text -46, -34.5, "+"
align "right", "bottom"
text -49, -39, "%.0f V", V

# --- the four arms, as boxes laid along the wires -----------------------
# a box of half-length 6 and half-width 2.2 on a 45-degree wire: a and b
# are those two lengths resolved onto the axes
a = 6 * 0.7071
b = 2.2 * 0.7071
fill "rgb(250,249,245)"
width 0.5
poly -40 + a - b, 14 + a + b, -40 + a + b, 14 + a - b,
     -40 - a + b, 14 - a - b, -40 - a - b, 14 - a + b
poly -40 + a + b, -14 - a + b, -40 + a - b, -14 - a - b,
     -40 - a - b, -14 + a - b, -40 - a + b, -14 + a + b
poly -12 + a + b, 14 - a + b, -12 + a - b, 14 - a - b,
     -12 - a - b, 14 + a - b, -12 - a + b, 14 + a + b
fill "#e8dcc8"
poly -12 + a - b, -14 + a + b, -12 + a + b, -14 + a - b,
     -12 - a + b, -14 - a - b, -12 - a - b, -14 - a + b
nofill

# R3 is the rheostat: an arrow drawn through its box, which the servo
# turns -- tied to the motor by a dotted shaft
width 0.5
line -19, 7, -4.5, 21.5
fill "#202020"
poly -3.5, 22.5, -6.5, 21.9, -4.1, 19.5
nofill
color "#606060"
width 0.35
dash "dot"
line -3.5, 22.5, xs - 3.4, 38
dash "solid"

# --- the labels -----------------------------------------------------------
color "#202020"
font 3.8
align "right", "middle"
text -45, 21, "R1 %.0f Ω", R1
text -45, -21, "R2 %.0f Ω", R2
align "left", "middle"
text -1, 15, "R3"
text -7, -21, "Rx %.1f Ω", Rx
color "#8a5a2b"
font 3.2
text -7, -26, "Pt100, %.0f °C", T
color "#202020"
font 3.4
align "left", "bottom"
text xa + 1.5, ya + 1, "A"
align "right", "middle"
text xb - 1.5, 0, "B"
align "left", "top"
text xa + 1.5, yc - 1, "C"
align "left", "middle"
text xd + 1.5, 0, "D"

# --- the galvanometer --------------------------------------------------------
fill "rgb(250,249,245)"
width 0.6
circle xa, 0, 8
nofill
width 0.3
line xa, 5.4, xa, 7
font 2.8
align "centre", "middle"
text xa, -6.4, "G"
color "#202020"
width 0.5
line xa, -3, xa + 8.4 * sin(phi), -3 + 8.4 * cos(phi)
color "#c0392b"
line xa / off, -3, xa + 8.4 * sin(phi), -3 + 8.4 * cos(phi)
color "#202020"
fill "#202020"
circle xa, -3, 0.7
nofill

# --- the motor and the rheostat's dial -------------------------------------
y0  = -36
y1  = 28
yp  = y0 + (y1 - y0) * R3 / R3max
width 0.5
circle xs, 38, 3.4
font 3.2
text xs, 38, "M"
color "#606060"
width 0.35
dash "dot"
line xs, 34.6, xs, yp
dash "solid"
color "#202020"
width 0.5
line xs, y0, xs, y1
width 0.3
repeat 9
  line xs, y0 + (y1 - y0) * i / 8, xs + 1.5 + 1.5 * (i % 2 == 0), y0 + (y1 - y0) * i / 8
end
font 2.8
align "left", "middle"
repeat 5
  text xs + 4, y0 + (y1 - y0) * i / 4, "%.0f", 100 * i
end
fill "#606060"
rect xs - 2, y1, 4, 1
fill "#c0392b"
rect (xs - 2) / (R3 >= R3max - 0.001), y1, 4, 1
fill "#3a5a9b"
color "#3a5a9b"
poly xs - 0.5, yp, xs - 4, yp + 1.8, xs - 4, yp - 1.8
nofill

# ========================================================================
#  THE READOUT
# ========================================================================
color "#202020"
font 4.6
align "left", "top"
text 29, 46, "Self-balancing"
text 29, 41, "bridge"
font 4
text 29, 32, "R3 = R1·Rx / R2"
text 29, 27, "     = %.1f Ω", R3
text 29, 21, "Ig = %.1f µA", uA
color "#3a5a9b"
font 4.6
text 29, 12, "reads %.1f °C", Tm
color "#c0392b"
font 3.8
text 29 / off, 5.5, "off the end of R3"
